summary: Defines version 3 of the Entity MIB, which lets one SNMP agent describe the multiple physical and logical entities it manages, such as chassis, modules and ports. It obsoletes version 2 from RFC 2737. This standards-track document was itself replaced by RFC 6933.

eli5.summary: A big network box is made of many pieces, like cards and fans. This memo gives a standard way for the box to list all its parts so a manager can see what is inside.
